# #2655: Patch: Legendary (animated) and Mythic (signed) full-art tiers, and fifteen more iconic cards join the full-art club
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Two changes to full-art faces (R1017001, R1313000, R1655000, §14.2):

**1. Two chase tiers for every full art.** Today each full-art card has one `fullArt` cosmetic, Epic. Each full-art card gets two more variants on the cosmetics' own scale (§14.2, R1333000):

| Tier | What it looks like |
|---|---|
| **Epic** (today's) | The static full art, unchanged |
| **Legendary**, *animated* | The full art moves: a slow drift or parallax of the art inside its crop, with a light sweep over it. CSS or SVG only, no new art files. It runs wherever that copy prints its full art |
| **Mythic**, *signed* | Everything the Legendary does, plus the card **signs its own name in cursive** across the art: the card's name written stroke by stroke, like a pen signature, then held on the face |

- **Every full-art card gets both new tiers**: the six existing ones (Big D-fender `core-001`, Gary the Gambler `core-004`, Mr. Vanilla `core-008`, Tempo Timmy `core-011`, Duplicating Felinors `core-012`, Jlockeed Shredder-10 `core-013`) and the fifteen below.
- **Ids** follow the existing ones: `full-art-<slug>` (Epic, unchanged), `full-art-<slug>-animated` (Legendary), `full-art-<slug>-signed` (Mythic).
- **Chases.** The Legendary and Mythic variants are chases, with the registry's chase mark set. No token pays for them (R1305003). They drop through the chase routes of §14.2 and §14.3: a duplicate's cosmetic roll, a cosmetic pack slot, or a full Chase Shard bar.
- **Granted to no account.** Like every cosmetic added since R1833000, these are earned, by existing accounts too.
- **The registry check changes.** R1313000 refuses "a card with two full arts". Change it to refuse two full arts **of the same rarity** on one card. Each full-art card then has exactly one Epic, one Legendary and one Mythic.
- **The pick.** A card's full-art pick (R1655000, `writeCardFullArt` in `apps/web/src/cards/cosmetics.ts`) chooses which owned full art the card wears: off, Epic, Legendary or Mythic. This goes everywhere the pick is chosen: the collection's card cosmetics view, `EquipButton`, the pack reveal's equip (R1955000), and the token offer on a locked one (R1953001, R2480000). The server checks the pick against ownership as it does today (R1834001). The opponent's, a watcher's and a replay's view show the tier from the owner's frozen loadout (R1834002, R1834004).
- **Reduced motion.** Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the Legendary shows a still frame and the Mythic shows its signature already complete. Gate the motion under `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)`, as `foil.test.ts` checks for chase cosmetics (R1953001).
- **The cursive.** The signature uses a self-hosted script font with an OFL or similar licence, kept in the app (no new CDN), or SVG paths. A Chinese face signs its English name unless the builder finds the Chinese name reads well. Record the choice in the ruling.
- **Settings and lessons.** The Full-art cards setting and a tutorial lesson's board (R1108000) turn off every tier.

**2. Fifteen iconic cards join the full-art club.** Full art stops meaning "the hero-portrait roster". `FULL_ART_NAMES` in `apps/web/src/cards/fullArt.ts` is built from `PORTRAITS` today. Instead, a card prints full art when the cosmetics registry has a `fullArt` entry for its card id, so the registry is the one list. The six portrait cards keep theirs. This amends R1017001's "the list is the portrait roster itself".

Each of these cards gets an Epic, a Legendary and a Mythic full art:

| Card | Id | Tokens that also print full art |
|---|---|---|
| League of Losers | `classicplus-019` | Top Loser `-019-1`, Jungle Loser `-019-2`, Mid Loser `-019-3`, Support Loser `-019-4`, Bot Loser `-019-5` |
| Bread and Butter | `core-018` | Bread Token `core-t-bread` |
| The Mother Pancake | `classicplus-012` | Devour `-012-1`, Death Boil `-012-2`, Fluffy Grip `-012-3`, Powder Spray `-012-4`, Anti-Waffle Shell `-012-5`, Frozen Wastes `-012-6`, Legion of the Hungry `-012-7`, Frostspatula `-012-8` |
| "Miss" Mrow | `core-086` | — |
| API Key Fishing | `meditative-021` | — |
| Felinor Flagbearer | `classicplus-046` | Felinor Flagbearer Prime `-046-1` |
| Dice of Doom | `stinkyscape-154` | — |
| KY's Papaya | `classicplus-062` | — |
| In Too Deep | `classic-090` | — |
| Jlockeed's Lobbyist | `classicplus-048` | — |
| Tatches the Totem | `meditative-087` | — |
| Buff Billy | `classicplus-069` | — |
| Goetzmann Game Design | `traininggrounds-040` | — |
| Tommy Tempo | `classicplus-026` | — |
| J-lease J-Jungle EX-plorer | `classicplus-075` | J-lease J-Jungle EX-plorer Pack `-075-1` |

**Tokens.** Tokens are never owned and never in packs, so they get **no registry entries**. A token in the table above prints full art, at the same tier, wherever its parent card's copy would. This works the way a Created card wears its generator's foil, finish and border (R1956001): the token wears the full-art pick of the card that made it, behind the same ownership, setting and lesson gates. The token's own art is cropped to the full face (R660: a delivered file first, the procedural picture otherwise). Keep the parent-to-token map as data next to the full-art list, not as names in code.

These are spells, field spells and traps as well as Units. The R1017001 face already drops a Unit's attack and health on a non-Unit, so check that every card type lays out cleanly: cost gem, rarity gem and set mark, crest, name banner, and the scrim.

**Count.** 6 × 2 + 15 × 3 = **57 new cosmetics** in `crates/server/cosmetics.json`: 15 Epic, 21 Legendary, 21 Mythic. Regenerate `apps/web/src/wire/generated/cosmetics.ts` and whatever else the registry feeds, such as `public.cosmetics` seeding, the way #1833 added its 36.

**Presentation only** (CLAUDE.md rule 7): no rule reads a full art. Nothing enters `PlayerView`, an action, the log or a replay hash. This is a change to how cards look, so it ships as a micro (R2529000) through a pending fragment (`cargo jackioh patches "<title>"`). Run `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` before pushing.

**Read first:** `spec/14-economy.md` §14.2, §14.3, §14.5, §14.6 and §14.12; R1017001, R1313000, R1333000, R1655000, R1833000, R1834001–R1834004, R1953001 and R1956001; `apps/web/src/cards/fullArt.ts`'s header; `crates/server/README.md`; `apps/web/README.md`; and `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 10).

### Acceptance

- [ ] New rulings in this issue's block, each with a proving test named after it (CLAUDE.md rule 3), and §11 paragraphs in `spec/pending/<this issue>.md`. They cover:
  - (a) the Legendary and Mythic full-art tiers and the registry check of one full art per rarity per card;
  - (b) the registry, not the portrait roster, as the list of full-art cards, amending R1017001 and R1313000;
  - (c) tokens wearing their parent's full art, amending R1956001;
  - (d) reduced motion and the signature's font and language.
- [ ] §14.2 updated so it no longer says every full art is Epic or names "six" full arts. R1017001's and R1313000's notes amended.
- [ ] The registry check (server test) refuses two full arts of one rarity on one card. It accepts one each of Epic, Legendary and Mythic, and sets the chase mark on exactly the Legendary and Mythic ones.
- [ ] `crates/server/cosmetics.json` holds the 57 new entries with the ids above. Every one of the 21 full-art cards has exactly one full art of each of the three rarities. None is a default, and none is granted to any account (store contract test, plus a migration if the registry needs one).
- [ ] A cosmetic token can buy an Epic full art of a new card and never a Legendary or Mythic one. A duplicate's chase roll or a Chase Shard buy can grant the new chases (server tests).
- [ ] Web tests:
  - Each of the 15 new cards prints full art when its full art is owned and picked, and its normal face otherwise. A card with no registry entry never prints full art.
  - The Legendary face carries the animated class and the Mythic face carries the animation and the card's name as the signature. Motion is gated under `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`. The opponent's copy shows the tier from the loadout.
  - Each listed token prints its parent's full art at the parent's tier. A token not in the table never does. A token whose parent's full art is unowned or off prints its normal face.
- [ ] The card cosmetics view, `EquipButton`, the pack reveal's equip and the token offer let you pick among owned tiers. A pick of an unowned tier is refused by the server.
- [ ] A component or pixel spec (`pnpm --dir e2e test:component`) shows one full-art face of each card type (Unit, Spell, Field Spell, Trap) at each tier, with nothing overlapping the cost gem, rarity gem, crest or name banner.
- [ ] A pending fragment claims the change, and `rust (classify)` passes.
- [ ] Green: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`. All five required checks are green on the PR (CLAUDE.md rule 12).

### Blocked by, part of

None. Related: #1313 (the six full arts become cosmetics), #1655 (per-card picks), #1953 (animated chase cosmetics), #1956 (Created cards wear their generator's picks).
